title: EPAAA: who can apply and how to apply
content:
### Who Can Apply?
Bachelor's or master's degree in any discipline. No pre-requisite programming skills.
### How to Apply?
Fill the registration form for the Executive Program in AI, Analytics & Automation (link on the programme page); you will hear from AIDTM; then pay the fee and confirm enrolment.
Contact: Mr. Alok Giri - 8851223902, or write to exedu@aidtm.ac.in

title: Admissions for PGDM Batch 2027-29: overview and selection
content:
### Inviting Application for Batch 2027-29
AIDTM's 2 flagship programs, PGDM (Big Data Analytics) and PGDM (AI & Data Science), are built to meet the needs of the industry with a bottom-up approach that helps learners grasp the core concepts of Big Data Analytics and Technology Management. Both courses expose students to trending advanced tools and technologies such as Big Data Analytics, Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning, Cloud Computing, Deep Learning, R / Python, Internet of Things, Statistical Modelling, Data Visualization, Cyber Security, Blockchain Technology, etc.
Documents listed on the Admissions page: Admission Policy (2027-29), PGDM Brochure (2026), and a Merit-Based Scholarship policy document. Their contents are PDF files and are not included here.
### Selection Process
Each applicant to the PGDM programme is holistically evaluated on several parameters. The parameters are shown as an image on the website and are not available as text.
Online application: https://www.aidtm.ac.in/apply-admission

title: Admission calendar and important dates
content:
### Admission Calendar
1 | Availability of online Application Forms at https://www.aidtm.ac.in/apply-admission and the Admission Office, AIDTM | 15-Oct-26 onwards
2 | Last Date of Receiving Filled-in Applications | As Per AICTE Norms
3 | PI (personal interview) Rounds for shortlisted Applicants | On rolling basis
4 | Release of Admission Offers to Selected Candidates | On rolling basis
5 | Last Date for Payment of Commitment Fees to Secure Admission | Within 10 days after receiving the offer
Note: any changes to the dates are at the discretion of the AIDTM Admission Committee. Applicants are advised to check the institute website regularly.

title: Application guidelines and documents needed
content:
Please register using a personal Email ID and Mobile Number.
The Email ID submitted at registration is used for all correspondence until enrolment is completed. A change in Email ID is NOT permitted under any circumstances.
The Application Form Fee is non-refundable.
Keep these documents ready before filling in the application form:
- Latest passport-size photograph and a scanned copy of your signature (preferably under 2 MB).
- Scanned copies of Xth, XIIth and Graduation documents. The candidate is responsible for providing accurate academic information.
- Work experience details (if any).
Apply online: https://www.aidtm.ac.in/apply-admission

title: Eligibility criteria: PGDM in Big Data Analytics
content:
### Eligibility Criteria (PGDM in Big Data Analytics)
Valid national-level entrance test score as per AICTE norms (CAT / XAT / CMAT / GMAT / MAT / ATMA).
Bachelor's degree with a minimum of 50% marks (45% for reserved categories) from a recognized university.
Final-year graduation students are eligible to apply.
Work experience is not mandatory, but relevant experience offers an added advantage.

title: Eligibility criteria: PGDM in AI & Data Science
content:
### Eligibility Criteria (PGDM in AI & Data Science)
Valid national-level entrance test score as per AICTE guidelines (CAT / XAT / CMAT / GMAT / MAT / ATMA).
Bachelor's degree in BE/B.Tech/M.Tech, B.Sc/M.Sc (IT, Computer Science, Data Science, AI, Cybersecurity, Software Engineering), BCA/MCA, or M.Sc (Maths/Statistics) with minimum 50% marks (45% for reserved categories) from a recognized university.
Final-year graduation students are eligible to apply.
Work experience is not mandatory, but relevant experience offers an added advantage.
